description: Phase 2A candidate-only pair-scoring baseline on the 75k benchmark candidate universe (fold-0 positions 0-74,999; frozen B+C+E blocker), with candidates generated on the Kaggle CPU reference platform in a separate benchmark work directory (artifacts/phase1c/work_bench), never the full Phase 1C run's directory.

split.unit: Source 1 entity (fold-0 BLAKE2b rank position); all pairs of an entity stay in one split
split.boundary_note: Boundaries are multiples of chunk_s1 (1,000); set before any model was trained.

sampling.note: Train only: every retrieved positive, the top-RRF negatives, and seeded random negatives. Validation and holdout use every candidate pair (natural distribution).
